# MeedyaDL 1.10.9

A quiet housekeeping release.

### Notes

- Updated the framework MeedyaDL is built on, and the libraries it uses, to their latest minor versions — nothing changes in how you use the app.
- Brought two newly reported security fixes into the tools used to build the app. Neither affected the app you install.
